name: SMERTEL'NYJ PLACKART!!! Samara — Voronezh.
source:
Den, an unlucky door salesman, is sent from Samara to Voronezh on his boss's orders. But his life turns upside down when he discovers a suitcase full of cash.

“DEATH TRAIN!!! Samara – Voronezh.” is an absurd comedic thriller. A kinetic novel about the dark side of freedom, trains, money, strong-willed people... and bears.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3762650/]Steam[/url]]
